jobs.title: Broken bench plank with exposed screw
jobs.instructions: Replace the broken plank, remove or cover exposed screws, check the frame.
jobs.why: High priority (sharp element next to a playground); crew has carpentry, a plank and a bolt kit.

jobs.title: Loose fence board at the playground
jobs.instructions: Check posts and boards; fix loose boards on the spot or open a follow-up.
jobs.why: Same playground as the bench: 5 min away, fits after it.

jobs.title: Streetlight off at the crossing
jobs.instructions: Isolate the circuit, replace the LED lamp, test at dusk mode.
jobs.why: High priority (unlit pedestrian crossing); gets the last LED lamp in stock.

unscheduled.reason: Blocked at 08:30 (wrong lamp model). The only LED lamp left goes to lamp 07, next to a pedestrian crossing (higher priority). Needs a new LED lamp.
Needs 20 paving stones; the furniture crew has 10 in stock.

changes.explanation: Lamp 11 waits: the last LED lamp in stock goes to lamp 07 (pedestrian crossing, higher priority).
Lamp 07 starts at 08:42 instead of 08:53: the crew is free earlier.

assumptions: Durations per job type from config/job_types.
Travel = straight-line distance x 1.3 at 20 km/h + 5 min to park.
Crews start and end at the municipal depot.
Jobs already started or done are not moved.
